summary: The Studio subsystem is the browser-based CMS editing surface — a multi-pane Phoenix LiveView that lets users create, edit, publish, and delete content documents across workspaces, projects, and datasets in real time. It is the primary human interface for content authorship in Barkpark.

intentions.title: Provide a multi-pane, real-time content editing environment
intentions.evidence: studio_live.ex: Structure→Type→Documents→Editor drill-down pane navigation, PubSub subscriptions (doc_updated, document_changed), presence tracking, and autosave/publish/discard-draft flows all serve live collaborative editing

intentions.title: Surface plugin-declared v2 field types in the editor without breaking legacy v1 fields
intentions.evidence: plugins/adapter.ex: v2?/1 gate + dispatch to FieldComponents for composite/arrayOf/codelist/localizedText; explicitly preserves v1 fall-through for legacy seed schemas (post, page, author, etc.)

intentions.title: Show content-graph blast-radius and reference topology for any document
intentions.evidence: graph_view.ex: Canvas2D force-sim renderer driven by server-derived node/edge topology; root-pinned BFS blast-ring layout encodes impact rank; unpublish guard in studio_live.ex probes reverse_referencers to block dangling-ref unpublish

intentions.title: Enable in-Studio editing of paper (block-document) content without leaving the CMS UI
intentions.evidence: paper_field_block.ex: per-composite-block LiveComponent that routes patch-block ops through the canonical paper_op/2 pipeline; studio_live.ex editor_view :paper mode subscribes to per-doc paper topic and applies deltas in place

intentions.title: Support collaborative real-time spreadsheet editing via a sheet grid pane
intentions.evidence: sheet_grid.ex: SheetGrid LiveComponent receives {:sheets_op, …} deltas forwarded from studio_live.ex; presence tracked per-sheet for cursor/selection display (Sheets M2/M4)

intentions.title: Hard multi-tenant isolation: scope every read, write, subscription, and presence to the active workspace/project/dataset
intentions.evidence: studio_live.ex: dataset URL-leaf validated against project membership; workspace switch gate (can_reach_workspace?, project-less workspace refused); PubSub topics are workspace-scoped; scope_opts threaded into every Content/Media call; upload stamped with workspace/project to avoid NULL-scope invisible rows

intentions.title: Allow in-Studio creation and switching of workspaces, projects, and datasets
intentions.evidence: studio_live.ex toggle-create/create-workspace/create-project/switch-workspace/switch-project/switch-dataset handlers; Tenancy.create_workspace_with_owner/2 + create_project_with_dataset/2; rescope_dataset_for_project cascades URL on every switch

intentions.title: Surface draft-vs-published diff and document history for editorial review
intentions.evidence: studio_live.ex toggle-diff handler + published_doc assign (diff_visible flag); show-history handler calls Content.list_revisions and restore-revision; discard-draft flow with modal confirmation

intentions.title: Plugin-owned content preview pane alongside the editor form
intentions.evidence: studio_live.ex content_preview_rendered assign set by Plugins.Registry.collect_content_renderer/3; toggle-content-preview event; fresh-install invariant: pane absent when no plugin contributes a renderer

intentions.title: Admin-controlled network sharing and per-document share links (Google-Docs-style)
intentions.evidence: studio_live.ex shares_admin? gate; shares-* handlers calling Barkpark.Sharing.*; item_share_open popover minting /s/<token> direct-doc links; admin re-checked in every handler as security boundary, not just UX gate
